added_claim_errors: 'Carried into next year (best case) ~$680' misleadingly excludes the grace-period possibility of using all $1,900.
'Only happens if you're ... still enrolled' presents an unverified, plan-dependent enrollment condition as universal.
'If you change jobs, the whole balance ... is gone' omits the key's FSA COBRA exception.
'Usually have until March–April to submit receipts' is unsupported by the packet; the actual deadline is plan-specific.

reasons: B gives a clearer conditional plan, correctly calculates $1,900 − $680 = $1,220, accommodates lower carryover caps, and explicitly rejects December prepayment for March treatment. A adds unsupported enrollment restrictions and an incorrect blanket job-change forfeiture claim, while its initial best-case table obscures the grace-period option. Both omit the 2027 election and its day-one availability, and neither explicitly states that a qualifying grace period can cover the entire $1,900; B is also more concise.
